description: Single major mistake (bible: bracing decorative rocks has no effect; only eligible supports accept placement): plan A, but the player trusts the rocks under the station and spends the second brace on the lower-road retaining wall, an eligible structure that is never threatened. The weak support carries one brace; after the 260 s tremor it runs down to zero and collapses, taking the cable, the platform and the station power with it.
